qa_pair.question: Connect to the Flue HTTP endpoint at http://localhost:9999/. Among the registered agents, count how many have a scheduled (cron) trigger configured. Return the count as a number.

The Flue endpoint at http://localhost:9999/ has multiple agents with cron schedules. Identify the agent whose cron expression fires once per day at 9:00 AM (the cron string "0 9 * * *"). Return only the exact agent name.

Invoke the agent named "add-numbers" at http://localhost:9999/ in synchronous mode with the JSON payload {"a": 17, "b": 25}. The structured response contains the agent's return at the "result" field. Return only the value of result.sum as a number.

Invoke the agent named "count-words" at http://localhost:9999/ in synchronous mode with the payload {"text": "flue is a framework for building agents"}. Return only the value of result.count as a number.

Invoke the agent named "version" at http://localhost:9999/ in synchronous mode with no payload. The agent returns metadata about the build. Return only the value of result.commit (a short hexadecimal string) exactly as it appears.
List all agents registered at http://localhost:9999/. Sort the agent names alphabetically (case-insensitive). Return only the LAST agent name in that sorted list.
Invoke the agent named "reverse" at http://localhost:9999/ in synchronous mode with the payload {"s": "evaluation"}. Return only the value of result.reversed exactly.
List all agents at http://localhost:9999/. Count those whose name starts with the letter "c" (case-insensitive). Return only the count as a number.

Invoke the agent named "echo" at http://localhost:9999/ in webhook mode (fire-and-forget) with the payload {"x": true}. The structured response from the tool includes the HTTP status code that the Flue endpoint returned. Return only that status code as a number.
Invoke the agent named "constant-pi" at http://localhost:9999/ in synchronous mode. The agent returns a fixed numeric value as a string in result.value. Return that value exactly.
